title: Record
description: One unit of runtime output as a descriptor reads it, or one report of a setup command that runs inside the wall: the source it came from and the record itself. The shape of the lines a hook forwarder and a setup runner write to the local socket, and of a descriptor fixture's records.jsonl.

source.description: output for a JSON line the runtime printed on its standard output; hooks for the JSON a hook command received on its standard input; setup for a report of a setup command, which the session writes as the command's setup step and no descriptor's rule maps.

record.description: The JSON object as the runtime produced it, unchanged; for setup, command, the command's number from 1, and event: started, line with stream (stdout or stderr), bytes (the line in standard base64) and, on a line the runner writes about its own failure to start or wait for the command, runner true, or exited with exit_code (0 to 255).
